# Cases whose expected value no source independent of the emulator settles yet, kept outside
# scalars/ so that no test runs them. Each query stands alone, without the scalars fixture, and is
# followed by an empty "?>" line. A maintainer fills those in with BigQuery's answers through
# `just bigquery-answers PROJECT`; each answered case then moves to scalars/, written with "=>",
# or with "!>" to known_bugs.txt where the emulator answers otherwise.

SELECT CAST(x AS STRING) FROM UNNEST([CAST('-0' AS FLOAT64)]) AS x
?>

SELECT CAST(x AS STRING) FROM UNNEST([CAST(1e20 AS FLOAT64)]) AS x
?>

SELECT CAST(x AS STRING) FROM UNNEST([CAST(0.1 AS FLOAT64)]) AS x
?>

SELECT CAST(x AS STRING) FROM UNNEST([TIME '01:02:03.12']) AS x
?>

SELECT CAST(x AS STRING) FROM UNNEST([DATETIME '2006-01-02 12:34:56.12345']) AS x
?>

SELECT CAST(x AS STRING) FROM UNNEST([TIMESTAMP '2006-01-02 12:34:56.12345+00']) AS x
?>

SELECT CAST(CAST(x AS TIMESTAMP) AS STRING) FROM UNNEST(['2014-01-31 12:12:34 America/Los_Angeles']) AS x
?>

SELECT ARRAY_TO_STRING(CAST(x AS ARRAY<STRING>), ',') FROM (SELECT [CAST(1.5 AS FLOAT64), 2] AS x)
?>

SELECT SAFE.TIMESTAMP(x, 'UTC') IS NULL FROM UNNEST(['2008-12-25 15:30:00+00']) AS x
?>

SELECT SAFE.TIMESTAMP(x) IS NULL FROM UNNEST(['2008/12/25 15:30:00']) AS x
?>

# Whether a variable keeps a NULL array, which BigQuery returns to clients as an empty one.
DECLARE x ARRAY<INT64> DEFAULT [1];
SET x = NULL;
SELECT x IS NULL
?>

SELECT LENGTH(AEAD.ENCRYPT(FROM_BASE64('CJmMp4UJEmQKWAowdHlwZS5nb29nbGVhcGlzLmNvbS9nb29nbGUuY3J5cHRvLnRpbmsuQWVzR2NtS2V5EiIaIP7Xj33VJoXuk9KMRwXsjkuDmo5P40WUSaVtJAzyve80GAEQARiZjKeFCSAB'), 'plaintext', 'abc'))
?>

SELECT TO_HEX(SUBSTR(AEAD.ENCRYPT(FROM_BASE64('CJmMp4UJEmQKWAowdHlwZS5nb29nbGVhcGlzLmNvbS9nb29nbGUuY3J5cHRvLnRpbmsuQWVzR2NtS2V5EiIaIP7Xj33VJoXuk9KMRwXsjkuDmo5P40WUSaVtJAzyve80GAEQARiZjKeFCSAB'), 'plaintext', 'abc'), 1, 5))
?>
